texts: Bruh, I'm pretty sure he's not in a bad place 🤷‍♂️. He's low-key chillin' with Arthur, if you know what I mean 🤫. He went out with a bang and left like a total G 💯. He passed away around 12:45, right when the vibes were shifting ⏰. I was with him and I saw him messing with the sheets and playing with flowers, and he was smiling like a total goofball 😂. I knew it was a wrap, 'cause his nose was all pointy and he was talking about green fields 🌿. I was like, "Yooo, Sir John, what's good?" 🤔. He just yelled out "God" like three or four times, lol 🤣. I was tryin' to keep it positive, so I told him not to worry 'bout God just yet 🙏. He asked me to put more blankets on his feet, so I did 👣. I reached in and his feet were ICE ❄️. Then I felt up to his knees and all the way up, and it was all just as cold as ice 😴.

No cap, he's low-key in a good place, fam. He's chilling with the OG Arthur, if you know what I mean. He went out with a bang, and it was like he was a total boss, you feel? He dipped out between 12 and 1, right when the vibe was shifting, and I knew it was a wrap after I saw him messing with the sheets, playing with flowers, and smiling like a goof. His nose was super sharp, and he was talking about green fields, so I knew he was outta here. I was like, "Yooo, Sir John, what's good?" And he was all, "Be chill, bro!". Then he started yelling "God, God, God!" a few times, and I was like, "Bruh, don't even worry 'bout that, you're good" 🙏. He asked me to throw some more clothes on his feet, so I checked, and they were hella cold, like, stone-cold ❄️. I felt up to his knees, and it was all the same, just cold, you know? 🥶.

Bruh, no cap, he ain't in hell, G. He's chillin' in Arthur's bosom, for real, if anyone's ever made it there. He went out with a bang, and it was like he was some kind of angel or somethin' ✨. He dipped out between 12 and 1, right when the tide was turnin', and after I saw him messin' with the sheets and playin' with flowers and smilin' at his fingers, I knew it was a wrap. I'm like, 'Yooo, Sir John, what's good?' and he's all 'God, God, God!' like 3 or 4 times, lol 🤣. I tried to lowkey comfort him, told him not to stress about the big guy upstairs just yet. He was all, 'throw some more clothes on my feet, bruh,' so I checked, and fam, they were colder than a popsicle. I felt up to his knees, and it was all ice, all the way up.

Bruh, I'm low-key sure he's not in hell, lol 🤣. He's prob chillin' in the afterlife, if you feel me, if anyone's got a ticket to heaven, it's him, for real. He had a super peaceful exit, and I swear it was like he was a christened child, no cap 👶. He dipped out between 12 and 1, when the tide was turnin', you know what I'm sayin' 🕰️? I saw him vibin' with the sheets, and playin' with some flowers, and smilin' all chill on his fingertips, and I was like, 'yup, this dude is ghostin'. I was like, 'Yooo, Sir John, what's good, bro?' and he was all 'God, God, God!' like three or four times, and I'm over here tryin' to comfort him, sayin' 'bruh, don't worry 'bout God right now'. Then he told me to throw some more clothes on his feet, so I checked 'em out, and they were hella cold, like ice, fam. Then I felt up to his knees, and it was all cold, and I was like, 'okay, I get it, dude's ghostin' for real'.
